en.why_it_matters: The instrument here is really the collision itself: Tao's piano and Teicher's feet turn rhythm into a two-body conversation, moving from Gershwin and Bach toward stride, contemporary composition, and theater. Counterpoint belongs in RADAR because its musical logic depends on being seen and heard live, not because Rhapsody in Blue is famous repertoire.
